summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, reporting updates on its achondroplasia clinical programs. The filing discloses topline Week 78 results from the Phase 2 COACH trial evaluating combination therapy with TransCon CNP and TransCon hGH, showing durable growth rates at or above the 97th percentile. It also reports Week 104 data from the pivotal ApproaCH trial of TransCon CNP monotherapy, highlighting durable height improvements and safety consistent with prior data. This is a routine clinical development update, not a special situation. No corporate transactions, tender offers, strategic reviews, or similar events are described.
